messages.subject: Plot Expected Score to ggplot2
parts:
Hi Phil

According to this example 

set.seed(12345)
a <- matrix(abs(rnorm(15,1,.3)), ncol=1)
d <- matrix(rnorm(15,0,.7),ncol=1)
itemtype <- rep('2PL', nrow(a))
N <- 1000
dataset1 <- simdata(a, d, N, itemtype)
dataset2 <- simdata(a, d, N, itemtype, mu = .1, sigma = matrix(1.5))
dat <- rbind(dataset1, dataset2)

# ensure 'Ref' is the first group (and therefore reference group during estimation)
group <- factor(c(rep('Ref', N), rep('Focal', N)), levels = c('Ref', 'Focal'))

mod <- multipleGroup(dat, 1, group = group,
                     invariance = c(colnames(dat)[1:5], 'free_means', 'free_var'))
coef(mod, simplify=TRUE)

empirical_ES(mod)
empirical_ES(mod, plot=TRUE)
​

Report the following plot


There is a way to extract the information from these codes to take them to ggplot.

Best regards

JV

parts:
You can compute expected item scores using the expected.item() function, then use these to build a plot:

set.seed(12345)
k_items <- 15
a <- matrix(abs(rnorm(k_items,1,.3)), ncol=1)
d <- matrix(rnorm(k_items,0,.7),ncol=1)
itemtype <- rep('2PL', k_items)

N <- 1000
dataset1 <- simdata(a, d, N, itemtype)
dataset2 <- simdata(a, d, N, itemtype, mu = .1, sigma = matrix(1.5))
dat <- rbind(dataset1, dataset2)

# ensure 'Ref' is the first group (and therefore reference group during estimation)
group <- factor(c(rep('Ref', N), rep('Focal', N)), levels = c('Ref', 'Focal'))

mod <- multipleGroup(dat, 1, group = group,
                     invariance = c(colnames(dat)[1:5], 'free_means', 'free_var'))
coef(mod, simplify=TRUE)

empirical_ES(mod)

theta <- seq(-4, 4, by = .01)
e_ref <- sapply(
  seq_len(k_items),
  \(i) expected.item(
    extract.item(mod, i, group = 1),
    Theta = matrix(theta)
  )
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  dplyr::mutate(theta = theta, .before = dplyr::everything()) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -theta,
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "expected",
    names_prefix = "V"
  )
e_foc <- sapply(
  seq_len(k_items),
  \(i) expected.item(
    extract.item(mod, i, group = 2),
    Theta = matrix(theta)
  )
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  dplyr::mutate(theta = theta, .before = dplyr::everything()) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -theta,
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "expected",
    names_prefix = "V"
  )
plot_dat <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ref = e_ref,
  focal = e_foc,
  .id = "group"
) |>
  # Make an even 16 panels
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    data.frame(item = "", group = "ref")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    item = factor(item, levels = c(seq_len(k_items), ""))
  )

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(plot_dat) +
  aes(x = theta, y = expected, color = group) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(vars(item)) +
  see::scale_color_material() +
  see::theme_modern()
